name: conformance-matrix
title: ConformanceMatrix
description: Checks by columns (transports, environments) as a real table. Every cell writes its result with a glyph and a word; finished cells select a detail panel.

a11y.pattern: <div role="region" tabindex="0" aria-label> > <table> with <caption>, <th scope="col">, <th scope="rowgroup"> per <tbody>, <th scope="row">; finished cells hold a <button aria-pressed>
keyboard: Moves between finished cells (buttons); queued and running cells are not stops. The scroll region is focusable when the table overflows
Selects the cell and shows its detail, or clears it when it is already selected
aria: Each cell button is named by a hidden "gRPC × eclair-size-m: " prefix followed by its visible text ("Failed 2.84 s") and uses aria-pressed
Every result is a glyph plus a word (Passed, Failed, Warning, Running, Queued); the tint and outline are secondary
Queued cells are dashed with muted text, never reduced opacity
A cell that spans every column uses colspan, so the table keeps its row and column headers
Announce progress in a live region elsewhere ("check 7 of 20"); the table itself is not live
a11y.notes: Put the detail of the selected cell in a named region under the table. For small screens keep the horizontal scroll inside the region, never on the page.
